data.title: Watch: Robots conquer 3,100 ancient steps in bold move to dominate world
data.description: While robot dogs feel like old news now, setting them the challenge of racing up more than 3,000 uneven stone steps on the side of a mountain is more than just to show off what machines with legs can do. It's a huge lesson in their training.
